mapper.select:
SELECT FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,create_time, #{createTime}) - 1)/3600) AS section, COUNT(1), create_time,
MAX(lampblack_data) as lampblackDataMax, CAST(AVG(lampblack_data) AS DECIMAL(10,3))as lampblackDataAvg,
MAX(matter_data) as matterDataMax, CAST(AVG(matter_data) AS DECIMAL(10,3))as matterDataAvg,
MAX(nmhc_data) as nmhcDataMax, CAST(AVG(nmhc_data) AS DECIMAL(10,3))as nmhcDataAvg
FROM ${table} WHERE point_mac = #{pointMac}
AND date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_SUB(#{createTime},INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') < #{createTime}
GROUP BY section

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BLD.lampblack_data > 1),0) as a1, IFNULL(SUM(BLD.matter_data > 5),0) as a2, IFNULL(SUM(BLD.nmhc_data > 10),0) as a3, IFNULL(SUM(BLD.lampblack_data = 0 or BLD.matter_data = 0 or BLD.nmhc_data = 0),0) as a4, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(lg.is_on = 0),0) FROM base_point_log lg where 1=1
and lg.time between date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) and now()
and lg.time between date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) and date_add(now(), interval -1 hour)
and lg.time between date_add(now(), interval -3 hour) and date_add(now(), interval -2 hour)
) as a5
FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD where 1=1
and BLD.create_time between date_add(now(), interval -1 hour) and now()
and BLD.create_time between date_add(now(), interval -2 hour) and date_add(now(), interval -1 hour)
and BLD.create_time between date_add(now(), interval -3 hour) and date_add(now(), interval -2 hour)
and BLD.point_mac = #{ids}

SELECT IFNULL(count(1),0) as a2, (SELECT IFNULL(count(1),0) FROM base_company WHERE fid_region = #{fidRegion}) as a1 FROM base_company BC WHERE BC.id in( SELECT BP.company_id FROM base_point BP,${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and BP.point_mac = BLD.point_mac and BP.fid_region = #{fidRegion} and (BLD.lampblack_data > 1 or BLD.matter_data > 5 or BLD.nmhc_data > 10) ) and BC.fid_region = #{fidRegion}

SELECT IFNULL(count(1),0) as a2, (SELECT IFNULL(count(1),0) FROM base_point WHERE fid_region = #{fidRegion}) as a1 FROM base_point BP WHERE BP.point_mac in( SELECT BLD.point_mac FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE 1=1 and (BLD.lampblack_data > 1 or BLD.matter_data > 5 or BLD.nmhc_data > 10) ) and BP.fid_region = #{fidRegion}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(sub.num=0),0) AS overproof FROM( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(BLD.lampblack_data > 1 or BLD.matter_data > 5 or BLD.nmhc_data > 10),0) as num, BP.point_mac as mac FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD RIGHT JOIN base_point BP ON BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BP.fid_region = #{fidRegion} WHERE BLD.create_time is not null and BLD.yyyymmdd = #{formatDay} GROUP BY BP.point_mac ) sub

SELECT count(sub.num) as total, SUM(sub.num=0) as offlineNum, (count(sub.num) - SUM(sub.num=0)) as onlineNum FROM( SELECT ( SELECT count(BLD.id) FROM ${tableLampblack} BLD WHERE BLD.point_mac = BP.point_mac and BLD.yyyymmdd = #{formatDay} )as num, BP.point_mac FROM base_point BP WHERE BP.fid_region = #{fidRegion} ) sub
